correctness.rationale: Full enumeration of 732802 faces agrees with a separate cyclic transfer polynomial. Both opposite-order 366383-pair discrete Morse matchings are checked acyclic on 5573766 incidences each, yielding one 0-cell, eighteen 6-cells, sixteen 7-cells. Both exact 18x16 integral boundaries admit 15 unimodular unit pivots with zero residual matrix; this makes the homology torsion-free and the remaining attaching maps cancel to three 6-spheres and one 7-sphere. Complete reproducible certificate files accompany the claim.

value.rationale: The paper arXiv:2307.12401 explicitly motivates torsion freeness for cycle products and leaves the 3r+2 cases unresolved. C11 is the next natural length of that residue class after C8; the exact 33-vertex calculation resolves one previously unlisted instance, determines both sphere multiplicities and rules out all Moore-space summands. This is a complete natural case, not a claim for the infinite family.
